info.name: Microsoft Azure Get Subscriptions Subscriptionid Resourcegroups Resourcegroupname Providers Microsoft Network Dnszones Zonename Recordtype

params.name: zoneName
params.description: The name of the DNS zone (without a terminating dot).

params.name: recordType
params.description: The type of DNS record in this record set.

params.name: $top
params.description: The maximum number of record sets to return. If not specified, returns up to 100 record sets.

params.name: $recordsetnamesuffix
params.description: The suffix label of the record set name that has to be used to filter the record set enumerations. If this parameter is specified, Enumeration will return only records that end with .<recordSetNameSuffix>

items.docs: Lists the record sets of a specified type in a DNS zone.
